text_block_list.text:
Going full throttle and enjoying the race, 
Maruzensky delivered results.

In high spirits, she decided to enter the 
Spring Stakes as a stepping stone toward 
the Classic races.

While Maruzensky enjoyed the race from the 
bottom of her heart...

Her overwhelming stride appeared as an 
insurmountable wall in the eyes of the 
Umamusume who ran alongside her.
